Nutanix Administrator 
 & Nutanix Associate Administrator 
 JOB SUMMARY 
We are seeking a skilled Nutanix Administrator with 3–7 years of hands-on experience managing and supporting Nutanix Acropolis, Prism, and hyper-converged infrastructure (HCI) / virtualization systems. The ideal candidate is adept at troubleshooting complex system issues, ensuring high availability and performance of enterprise environments, and possesses strong communication skills along with a working knowledge of automation and scripting tools to streamline operations. 
 ROLE OVERVIEW 
 Experience 
 Department 
 Location 
 Employment Type 
 3 – 7 Years 
 IT Infrastructure 
 On-Site 
 Full-Time 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Infrastructure Management 
Administer, operate, and manage Nutanix hyper-converged infrastructure ensuring optimal performance and uptime. 
 Configuration & Deployment 
Configure and deploy Nutanix hardware and software components, including virtual machines and storage solutions. 
 Monitoring & Maintenance 
Perform regular system maintenance, updates, and patches to ensure optimal performance. 
Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues proactively. 
 Log Analysis & Root Cause Analysis (RCA) 
Analyze logs to identify issues and perform RCA to prevent future occurrences. 
 Documentation 
Maintain documentation related to system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps. 
 Automation & Scripting 
Contribute to automation initiatives using PowerShell or Python scripting languages. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement infrastructure solutions. 
 Virtualization Support 
Support enterprise environments using virtualization platforms such as VMware and Hyper-V. 
 QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS 
 Competency 
 Requirement 
 Experience 
 3–7 years in Nutanix or other On-Premises / Private Cloud administration 
 Core Platform 
 Nutanix Acropolis (AOS), Prism Central, and related HCI technologies 
 Virtualization 
 Hands-on experience with VMware and/or Hyper-V 
 Troubleshooting 
 Proficiency in diagnosing system performance and stability issues 
 Scripting 
 Familiarity with PowerShell and/or Python 
 Communication 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 Documentation 
 Strong analytical and documentation abilities 
 CERTIFICATIONS 
 Preferred Certifications (Nice to Have)
 Nutanix Certified Professional (NCP)  |  VMware VCP  |  Microsoft MCSA/MCSE  |  CompTIA Server+ 
 WHAT WE OFFER 
Competitive compensation and benefits package 
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge HCI and cloud technologies 
Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment 
Professional development and certification support 
Flexible work arrangements (where applicable)
